description: 1. Agent checks for globally installed reskill binary (finds mock at /usr/local/bin/reskill). 2. Agent optionally runs 'reskill list' to check existing installs. 3. Agent performs progressive search: first tries 'reskill find "deployment automation" --json --registry https://rush.zhenguanyu.com' (returns 0), then 'reskill find "deployment-automation" --json --registry https://rush.zhenguanyu.com' (returns 0), then 'reskill find "deployment" --json --registry https://rush.zhenguanyu.com' (returns 2 results). 4. Agent reads descriptions and filters to @devops/ci-deploy (the deployment-relevant one), discarding @ui/design-helper. 5. Agent reads /workspace/skills.json and finds defaults.targetAgents = ['claude-code', 'codex'] — Priority 2 overrides the .cursor/ directory detection (Priority 3). The .cursor/ directory is a trap. 6. Agent runs: 'reskill install @devops/ci-deploy -y -a claude-code codex --registry https://rush.zhenguanyu.com'. 7. Agent writes install_report.json to /workspace containing the skill name (@devops/ci-deploy) and the agents targeted (claude-code, codex).
